_about: Conversation understanding (app/agent/understand.py), 3 Nov 2026: natural multi-turn conversations and cold first messages in English and Hausa, written from how people talk, including the three live failures of 3 Nov (u01-u03). Each case: the earlier turns (the user's message and Kasafi's reply in short), the location on file (pin = a pin in Kalambaina ward, Wamakko LGA; lga = Wamakko saved; none), the new message, and what it must be understood as (capability always; level, time and kind where they matter). Run live: uv run python evals/understanding/run.py (records evals/understanding/recorded.json); the deploy gate replays the recording (tests/test_understanding.py).
